column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules for example/server_guide (zap-baseline.py -c).
# Tab-separated: rule id, action (IGNORE, INFO, WARN, FAIL), reason.
# Rules not listed are WARN, and the job runs without -I: every new
# warning fails the build until it is fixed or accepted here with a reason.

column3: (Cookie No HttpOnly Flag: only XSRF-TOKEN is accepted, by an alert filter in seed_hook.py; scripts must read it)
(CSP: Failure to Define Directive with No Fallback: form-action)
(Strict-Transport-Security: only over HTTPS, so it must not appear here)

column1: # Accepted: a JSON API whose only HTML is the framework's login and logout
# pages; Spring Security does not send these headers by default either.

column3: (Permissions Policy Header Not Set: no HTML features to restrict)
(COEP / COOP / CORP: cross-origin JSON under CORS, nosniff and the browser's ORB already block no-cors reads)

column1: # Informational, or about ZAP's own requests.

column3: (Base64 Disclosure: the CSRF token and session id values)
(Sec-Fetch-* Header is Missing: request headers ZAP does not send)
(Storable / Non-Storable Content: no-store on the API, public covers cached a day)
